Rich, accessible cell tooltips

Source: R/tooltips.R
reactable-tooltips.Rd

Tooltips appear on hover or keyboard focus and close with Escape. Content must be noninteractive. Use ordinary text (escaped automatically), or trusted htmltools::tags / htmltools::HTML() for formatting. Do not pass untrusted HTML, links, controls, scripts, or htmlwidgets.

Usage

reactableTooltip(content, placement = "top", maxWidth = 320, class = NULL)

updateReactableTooltip(session, inputId, tooltip)

Arguments

content

Text or trusted noninteractive HTML content.

placement

Preferred position: "top", "bottom", "left", or "right". Tooltips flip and stay within the viewport when space is limited.

maxWidth

Maximum width in CSS pixels. Defaults to 320.

class

Additional CSS classes for the tooltip.

session

The Shiny session.

inputId

Local input ID of a mounted editable cell.

tooltip

A tooltip, text, trusted HTML, or FALSE to hide it.

Value

reactableTooltip() returns a tooltip definition. updateReactableTooltip() returns invisibly.

Details

Set defaults with colDef(tooltip = ..., headerTooltip = ...), or use reactable(tooltips = ...). Rules are named lists: rows = list(key = tooltip), columns = list(column = tooltip), cells = list(key = list(column = tooltip)), and headers = list(column = tooltip). Rows and cells require rowId. Rules follow stable keys across sorting, pagination, virtual scrolling, additions and data replacement.

Priority is per-input override, cell, row, table column, then colDef. FALSE explicitly hides a tooltip. updateReactable(tooltips = list()) clears table rules and per-input overrides, but keeps column defaults. NULL leaves rules unchanged during updates. updateReactableTooltip() targets a mounted native editor by input ID, automatically namespaced by Shiny. Its override persists after remounts and data replacement. This helper requires an active session.

Examples

reactable(
  mtcars,
  columns = list(mpg = colDef(
    tooltip = function(value) paste("Fuel economy:", value),
    headerTooltip = reactableTooltip(htmltools::tags$b("Miles per gallon"))
  ))
)
